name: Joseph
description: Main character of Kaotika, as powerful as malevolent.
deskripzioa: Kaotikaren protagonista, hain indartsu eta gaizto dena.

name: Lucretia
description: The enigmatic heroine, harboring chaotic tendencies and wielding malevolent powers.
deskripzioa: Protagonista enigmatikoa, joerik kaotikoak izaten dituena eta indar gaiztoak erabiltzen dituena.

common_effect.common_effect_description: Applies -1 to defense of enemy minions.
common_effect.common_effect_deskripzioa: Minion sarraski guztiei -1 defentsa kentzen du

name: Villager
description: An unfortunate person who got involved in the inn battle
deskripzioa: Inn bataila sarrera hartu zuten nahaste pertsona

name: Whip of Multilash
description:
Once belonged to a vile lord of the valley, traded for some barrels 
 of liquor and awaits to be wielded by some acolyte
deskripzioa: Harana ospe txarreko jaun batekin lotuta zegoen denbora batez, likore botatxo batzuk trukatu eta akolito batek erabiltzeko itxaroten dago.

name: Leather Armor
description: Obtained from the skins of valley creatures, they were used in the war of the third era of Kaotika
deskripzioa: Haran-izakiak azalak erabiliz lortu ziren, Kaotika hirugarren aroko gerran erabil ziren.

name: Rotten Snack
description: The cursed subject eats a rotten snack, which severely affects them.
deskripzioa: Malenkantu gaiak fruitu zaparrada bat jaten du, eta horrek larriki eragiten die.

common_effect.common_effect_description: Reduces the opponent minion attack by 2
common_effect.common_effect_deskripzioa: Minion guztien defentza murrizten du 2 puntuetan

common_effect.common_effect_description: Reduces the opponent minion defense by 1
common_effect.common_effect_deskripzioa: Minion oposatzailearen defentsa puntu batez murrizten da

name: Boiling Oil
description: Boiling oil, employed on the battlefield, is crafted in wooden vessels within the confines of dungeons.
deskripzioa: Olio beroa, gerra eremuan erabiltzen dena, haitzuloetan egurrezko ontzi batean zirriborroa burutzeko erabiltzen da.

common_effect.common_effect_description: Splash boiling oil on an enemy, dealing 5 damage.
common_effect.common_effect_deskripzioa: Uhera olio beroa inorri baten gainean, 5 mina emanez.

name: Seminary brew
description: This beverage is donated by the faithful acolytes of the valley, its flavor suggests it has been stored for ages.
deskripzioa: Edaria hau haraneko fidel akolitoek ematen dute, bere saborak antzinako denborak itxita izan duela iradokitzen du

common_effect.common_effect_description: Increment objetive minion Attack by 2pts the next 2 turn
common_effect.common_effect_deskripzioa: Minion objektiboaren Attack 2 puntuetan igotzen du datorren bi txandetan
